header.name: Schleicher ASK 21 geometry approximation with control surfaces

versionInfo.creator: ChatGPT, checked by DLR-SL
versionInfo.description: Low-fidelity external geometry of a Schleicher ASK 21 sailplane with ailerons, elevator, rudder and upper-surface airbrakes. Public dimensions are used where available; unreported contours and airfoil coordinates are engineering approximations.

model.name: Alexander Schleicher ASK 21
model.description: Parametric CPACS example in SI units. CPACS axes: x tailwards, y toward right wing, z upwards. Tail control surfaces use inset spanwise borders and TiGL-compatible airfoil contour ordering.

fuselage.name: ASK 21 fuselage
fuselage.description: Low-fidelity loft of cockpit pod and tail boom. Local y/z scaling values are full width and height because the standard profile diameter is 1.

wing.name: ASK 21 main wing
wing.description: 17 m span wing. Root, aileron-start and tip chords follow public ASK 21 maintenance data. Airfoil contour is a placeholder, not the proprietary Wortmann coordinate set.

element.name: ASK 21 main wing aileron start element

componentSegment.name: ASK 21 inner wing component segment
componentSegment.description: Inner wing carrying the upper-surface Schempp-Hirth airbrake.

trailingEdgeDevice.name: ASK 21 aileron
trailingEdgeDevice.description: Aileron extent and hinge line reconstructed from published three-view and chord data. Deflection angles are derived approximately from maintenance-manual travel measurements.

wing.name: ASK 21 horizontal tail
wing.description: T-tail horizontal stabilizer using published area and root/tip chords. The root leading edge is aligned with the vertical-fin tip and the half-span positioning has 12 degrees positive sweep, producing the aft-swept planform visible in ASK 21 three-view drawings. Profile contour is an approximation.

trailingEdgeDevice.name: ASK 21 elevator
trailingEdgeDevice.description: Elevator occupies approximately 30 percent of stabilizer chord. Its CPACS borders stop short of the exact component-segment root and tip to avoid loft-cap intersection ambiguities in TiGL.

wing.name: ASK 21 vertical tail
wing.description: Vertical tail using published area and root/tip chords. With root x=6.98 m, z=0.41 m, positioning length 1.14 m and 18 degrees sweep, the tip leading edge lies near x=7.33 m, z=1.49 m and supports the T-tail. The root remains embedded in the upper tail-boom contour.

trailingEdgeDevice.name: ASK 21 rudder
trailingEdgeDevice.description: Rudder occupies approximately 31 percent of vertical-tail chord. It starts above the embedded fin root and ends below the T-tail junction; avoiding eta=0 and eta=1 also prevents ambiguous skin intersections at loft caps in TiGL.

wingAirfoil.name: Generic 15%-thick cambered glider wing profile
wingAirfoil.description: NACA-style placeholder used solely to provide a smooth TiGL-compatible contour. The ASK 21 uses Wortmann FX S02-series airfoils; their coordinates are not reproduced here. Point order follows the TiGL-compatible lower-TE, LE, upper-TE contour convention.

wingAirfoil.name: Generic symmetric 12%-thick tail profile
wingAirfoil.description: NACA-style symmetric placeholder. It is not claimed to reproduce the published Wortmann FX 71-L-150/30 contour. Point order follows the TiGL-compatible lower-TE, LE, upper-TE contour convention.

fuselageProfile.name: ASK 21 unit-diameter elliptical fuselage profile
fuselageProfile.description: CPACS standard superellipse with diameter 1. Section y/z scaling therefore represents full local width and height.
